title: Humanoid Robot Kinematic and Balance Constraints
description: Humanoid robots have unique kinematic and balance constraints that significantly impact navigation planning and execution. Unlike wheeled robots, humanoid robots must maintain dynamic balance while navigating, which introduces complex constraints that must be considered in Nav2 configuration and path planning.
